{{Nihongo|Galen|ガスト|Gasuto|Gust}} is a character in ''[[Harvest Moon: DS]] ''and ''[[Harvest Moon DS: Cute]].''

<gallery type="slideshow" widths="245">
Galen ds.png
Galen 2.png
Galen 4.png
</gallery>He lives with his wife [[Nina (DS)|Nina]] in their small home located on a hill in the south east corner of the valley. He retired here with Nina, and often walks around the valley taking in fresh air and looking at the scenery. Despite his gruff exterior, deep down he is very kind.

He likes living in the valley, away from the hustle and bustle of the city. He also has a love of fishing. If you befriend Galen, he will give you a fishing rod.

After your child is born, his wife Nina will die. If Nina never made a stocking before her death, Galen will give you a stocking instead. After Nina dies, Galen becomes more secluded and no longer leaves his home.
